summary.text: Matt Morgan is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 26 since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as managing director.

paragraphs.text: Matt Morgan was born in Houston, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Sam Houston State University in 2002.
His career experience includes working as a managing director and business owner, and he spent 10 years in the oil and gas industry.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Eagle Scout, Cub Scout leader and former Little League board member, and said he has volunteered with the Fort Bend Republican Party since 2017.
Morgan succeeded Jacey Jetton in the Texas House, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
